column1: # The ZooKeeper trees the cases run (each case.sh's repo=, under GC_TREES): the directory name and the branch of the
# ZooKeeper fork (ZOOKEEPER_FORK, prepare-trees.sh) it is checked out at (a branch or a tag).  It stands on the fork's master eab165995 (Apache
# ZooKeeper master, Java 8: maven.compiler.release 8; both ZOOKEEPER-5094 and ZOOKEEPER-5088 present), with the adapter,
# the cases' target markers and workloads. zookeeper-checks is the fork's tag graphchecker/zookeeper-checks-liftlab
# (51b213562), the tree results/zookeeper was made on; the branch graphchecker/zookeeper-checks has since gained
# CloudLab's three workload workarounds (889f0e961), which the buggy-detect trees carry.

column3: every ZooKeeper case: the automatic ClientBase cluster (CausynthZkCluster), client requests and replies as messages (CausynthZk), the cases' target markers and workloads
